bricks.name: Travel Products and Packages
bricks.description: System of record for everything a travel organisation sells: group round trips and coach tours with fixed departure series, tailor-made journey templates, single-day products and add-on options. Each product carries its day-by-day programme, included components, applicable price tables, sales channels and validity, in every language and currency the tenant sells in. Product Management in 1TIS GRIP and travel plans/products in the TravelSpirit BackOffice both live here; the brick publishes sellable product versions to the customer website, reseller portal and partner feeds so that the same product definition is bookable everywhere without re-keying.

bricks.name: Components, Inventory and Availability
bricks.description: Catalog of the individual building blocks a trip is composed of: accommodations and room types, coach and flight legs, transfers, excursions, guides, insurances and extras. Each component holds its supplier, service period, allotments and free-sale rules, release dates, option expiry and stop-sales, and its availability calendar. Real-time availability answers for the website, booking desk and Visual Tour Builder are computed here, and bed-bank and Airtrotter content is imported as externally sourced components so that group and tailor-made operators can mix contracted and dynamically sourced inventory in one trip.

bricks.name: Pricing, Yield and Group Calculations
bricks.description: Turns purchase costs into sales prices: price tables per season, room type and age category, supplements and discounts, early-booking and last-minute rules, currency conversion and margin targets. For group and coach operators it runs group calculations that compute the price per participant from fixed costs (coach, guide) and variable costs at different occupancy levels, and yield rules that adjust prices as departures fill. For tailor-made specialists it prices a composed itinerary line by line at target margin. The calculation engine is shared by the website, booking desk, Visual Tour Builder and reseller portal so that every channel quotes the same price.

bricks.name: Supplier Management and Communication
bricks.description: Supplier master data and the one-to-one data exchange with hotels, coach companies, DMCs and other direct suppliers. Every booking line that needs a supplier service becomes a supplier request with a status (requested, confirmed, rejected, changed, cancelled); the brick sends requests and change notices by email or to the supplier portal, logs every communication with the supplier and keeps the booking in sync with confirmations. It is the engine behind 'keep suppliers and DMCs in sync with every change' for group operators and behind confirming ad-hoc components for tailor-made specialists.

bricks.name: Booking Files and Dossiers
bricks.description: The booking file (dossier) is the heart of the ERP: one record per trip sold, holding travellers, booked components and departure, options and deadlines, price and payment schedule, supplier request status, documents and every communication. Reservation agents work here to make bookings and options, handle changes and cancellations, and answer any customer question from one view; the website, reseller portal and Visual Tour Builder create bookings through the same orchestrator. Booking events fan out to departures, supplier requests, invoicing, workflows, documents and BI, which is what makes the integrated model compound.
